build_gdb_pretty_printer: build a GDB pretty printer collection for boost unordered containers using RegexpCollectionPrettyPrinter
create_fca_printer: create a BoostUnorderedFcaPrinter to visualize unordered_map and unordered_set bucket chains in GDB
create_foa_printer: create a BoostUnorderedFoaPrinter to visualize flat and node map/set arrays in GDB
register_xmethod_get_stats: register an xmethod to call get_stats on boost unordered flat or node containers
create_fancy_pointer_customization: create boost_to_address and boost_next methods to support custom fancy pointer types with GDB printers
